title: Semio Repo IDs and Checkpoint in All Events
description: All semio repo event information should use semio repo IDs. Add checkpoint (commit SHA from git provider) to all events. Ensure folder/file/line/range/section/definition IDs follow the semio-repo ID scheme. Add Checkpoint field to HookResultAgentBase and all version result types.

interactions.summary: Added Checkpoint field to HookResultAgentBase and all version result types (CheckpointStarting, CheckpointEnded, CheckoutStarting, CheckoutEnded). Updated dispatchHook to resolve currentCheckpoint at function start via DefaultVersionControlProvider().CurrentCheckpoint() and populate it in all events. Renamed ID→Checkpoint in CheckpointEnded/CheckoutEnded. Updated extractCheckpointIDFromResult. Fixed mmss→hhmmss variable bug in logHook. Added 4 new tests: TestCheckpointInAllAgentEvents (17 subtests), TestCheckpointInAllVersionEvents (6 subtests), TestCheckpointInLoggedEventJSON, TestEventIDsUseSemioRepoFormat. All tests pass.
